title: Jazzy Light Middle Eastern Seafood Wrap
description: A sour and light Middle Eastern dish featuring seafood stock, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware and wrapped in a corn husk, high in protein and perfect for a quick fix. This dish combines the flavors of the Middle East with the freshness of seafood.
instructions: Preheat the ttukbaegi earthenware over medium heat.
Add the olive oil, garlic, sumac, and paprika to the earthenware and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp to the earthenware and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Add the seafood stock and lemon juice to the earthenware and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm the corn husks by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the seafood mixture onto a corn husk and topping with parsley and mint.
